title: The Silvervein Mine
objective: Kobolds have dug into the old Silvervein mine, and worse things stir below. Take what silver you can and get back out of the mine mouth alive.

rooms.name: Mine Mouth
rooms.description: A timbered adit opens in the hillside, its beams black with age. Fresh spoil spills down the slope, and a rail track runs into the dark.

features.name: Overturned Ore Cart
features.description: A rusted ore cart lies on its side across the rails.
features.discovery: The cart is empty. Dozens of small clawed footprints lead from it into the mine.

rooms.name: Sorting Shed
rooms.description: A low cavern where miners once sorted ore. Plank tables stand among heaps of broken rock, and the rail track runs on, deeper into the hill.

features.name: Ore Bin
features.description: A wooden bin of sorted ore, its lid weighted down with a stone.
features.discovery: Under the ore lie a stoppered vial of red liquid and a cloth bag of silver the kobolds have scraped together.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Kobolds' Takings
items.description: A cloth bag of tarnished silver pieces.

items.name: Iron Key
items.description: A heavy iron key on a loop of greasy cord.

items.name: Kobold Lookout's Coins
items.description: A greasy pouch of copper pieces.

items.name: Kobold Tunneller's Coins
items.description: A greasy pouch of copper pieces.

rooms.name: Main Gallery
rooms.description: A long gallery runs between rotten pit props. Side passages branch off: one dripping, one hung with grey webs, and one closed by an iron door.

features.name: Notice Board
features.description: A board nailed to a pit prop, its notices curling with damp.
features.discovery: One notice can still be read: "Lower drift flooded. Six men lost. Pay held in the office until the pumps are mended."

rooms.name: Flooded Drift
rooms.description: Black water stands knee-deep in a low drift. Picks and lamps float among fallen timbers, and burial niches are cut into the dry wall.

features.name: Burial Niche
features.description: A niche cut into the wall above the waterline, stacked with old bones.
features.discovery: Among the bones lies a silver locket on a broken chain.

items.name: Silver Locket
items.description: A tarnished silver locket. Inside is a lock of a child's hair.

rooms.name: Webbed Winze
rooms.description: A steep shaft drops away, choked with grey webs. Husks of rats and kobolds hang in the strands.

features.name: Cocooned Prospector
features.description: A man-sized bundle of web hangs from a beam over the shaft.
features.discovery: Inside the cocoon is a dead prospector, still clutching a pouch. In it are an uncut sapphire and a vial of red liquid.

items.name: Uncut Sapphire
items.description: A rough blue stone the size of a thumbnail.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Overseer's Office
rooms.description: The old mine office, its shutters nailed closed. A ledger desk stands against one wall and a heavy chest against another.

features.name: Ledger Desk
features.description: A tall desk with a mouldering ledger open on it.
features.discovery: The last page lists six miners' names, each marked "drowned", and the words "pay held".

features.name: Payroll Chest
features.description: An iron-bound chest, its lid prised open.
features.discovery: The chest still holds the mine's last payroll, in sealed canvas bags.

items.name: Miners' Payroll
items.description: Sealed canvas bags of gold, the pay the drowned miners never drew.

items.name: Bugbear Overseer's Coins
items.description: A small pouch of silver pieces.

items.name: Bugbear Overseer's Rough Gem
items.description: A cloudy, roughly cut stone that a jeweller would buy.

passages.description: The rail track runs into the adit.
The track runs on into a long gallery.
A dripping passage slopes down to the water.
A side passage hung with grey webs.

door.name: Iron Door
door.description: A heavy iron door, bolted from the far side and locked.

opponents.name: Kobold Lookout
opponents.description: A kobold lookout yelps from a heap of rock and scrambles down, spike in hand.

opponents.name: Kobold Tunneller
opponents.description: A kobold tunneller, an iron key bouncing on a cord at its neck, comes at you from behind a table.

surrender.description: The tunneller throws down its spike and cowers behind a table, clutching the key at its neck.

topics.name: the webs
topics.reply: "Big spider in the winze. It ate Skrit. It ate Nub. Do not go in the webs!"

topics.name: the overseer
topics.reply: "The bugbear makes us dig. He keeps the miners' gold in a chest behind the iron door, and he hits very hard."

topics.name: the iron door
topics.reply: "The overseer gave me the key to fetch his supper. Take it, take it, only do not hurt me!"

opponents.name: Drowned Miner
opponents.description: A bloated miner rises out of the black water, pick still in its fist.

opponents.name: Miner's Bones
opponents.description: Bones climb out of a niche and pull themselves together around a rusted blade.
A giant spider drops from the dark on a line of silk, fangs dripping.

opponents.name: Bugbear Overseer
opponents.description: A bugbear in a miner's leather apron heaves itself up from behind the desk, a hammer in its fist.

endings.title: Out with the silver
endings.text: You climb out of the adit into daylight with the mine's silver in your pack.

endings.title: Out empty-handed
endings.text: You climb out of the adit into daylight with nothing to show for the mine but dust.

endings.title: Lost in the mine
endings.text: You fall in the dark under the hill. Your adventuring ends here.
